purpose: Replace the too-narrow roundoff-only R3 hypothesis with a stronger constitutive-independent physical root envelope for the positive-surface to unsaturated 5 cm face, and qualify a bounded exact-upper snap only when that envelope alone proves the flux error is inside the already frozen E3E accuracy budget.

upstream.revision_of_previous_hypothesis: The observed sign disagreement cannot honestly be attributed to binary64 arithmetic alone because the bounded candidate and high-precision reference also use different quadrature. R3 therefore uses a stronger exact physical flux envelope rather than an epsilon residual threshold. This is a strengthening, not a relaxation.

scope.normal_candidate: R2 analytic saturated-segment split plus existing bounded negative-head quadrature and fixed bisection
scope.snap_trigger: Only after the R2 split returns split_bracket_failure with both finite residuals positive at lo=nextafter(KSAT,+inf) and hi=KSAT*(1+(h_surface-h_top_node)/L).

theorem.meaning: The snap error bound does not depend on the sign or accuracy of the bounded quadrature residual at q_upper and therefore remains valid when that final residual sign is numerically ambiguous.

frozen_admission_limits.rule: A physical-envelope snap is admitted only when BOTH theorem-derived error bounds are within the existing frozen E3E limits. No residual tolerance is enlarged.

B01_defect.require: snap branch, two independent high-precision reference oracles agree, actual candidate error inside theorem bound and frozen metrics

O14_negative_control.require: either ordinary split solve or theorem-certified snap remains inside frozen metrics

architecture_checks.5_scratch_per_worker: No new persistent state. The theorem uses face-local geometry and parameters only.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: The gate changes only a single antisymmetric face flux candidate. No water is clipped, repaired, or discarded.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: The theorem is a face-contract property and does not expose HeadCalc internals.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: K<=KSAT and face geometry are physical facts; the snap admission limits are numerical policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: The snap is O(1) after an already bounded failed split bracket and adds no iterative trajectory.
architecture_checks.29_no_silent_dependencies: L=5 cm is explicit in this gate and no 10 cm table or hidden calendar/I/O assumption is used.

hard_nonclaims: No claim that the R2 sign disagreement was pure binary64 roundoff.
No Phi tuning, conductivity smoothing, table fit, heavier quadrature or constitutive change.
No unconditional q_upper snap outside the theorem-derived narrow error envelope.
No h_surface=0 change; R2P remains authoritative there.
No 320-case requalification until this focused R3 gate passes.
No full top-boundary, surface ledger, response tangent, runtime, MultiSWAP, groundwater or production admission.
